Name: CP Nintendo Furniture
Author: MrFox420
Description: This mod replaces a lot of the vanilla furniture, craftables, and wallpaper&flooring with Nintendo themed ones. I had help making it Content Patcher applicable. I added a lot of cool video game stuff to it, and I hope people will enjoy it. The vanilla stuff is pretty boring so I made this to make it more fun to collect lots of stuff. Now with new replaced furniture.

Downloads.Description: Added a few more floors for a good mix to go with the wallpapers.
